notes.title: Dev Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Dev update![/h1][p][/p][p]Hey everyone! Frankie here 😊 We’ve made some great progress since launching the Steam page, both on [i]Super Carpark[/i] and a few other exciting projects. I'll quickly sum up ever thing that's been going on.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]- Join Our Discord![/b][/h3][p][b]
[/b]We’ve set up a community Discord and would love to hang out, chat, and hear your thoughts: [url="https://discord.gg/7ChNhjwJjx"]https://discord.gg/7ChNhjwJjx[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][b]- New Project Demo: [i]Pigeon Hunter[/i][/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3917020/Pigeon_Hunter/"][/dynamiclink]We’ve just launched a demo for a brand new project called [i]Pigeon Hunter[/i]! It’s available across multiple platforms, but here’s the Steam link 👆[/p][p]It’s a special collaboration with my mum (yes, really!) so go check it out, and if you like it, don’t forget to wishlist it![/p][p][/p][h3][b]- [i]Squash and Spell[/i] Beta Now Supports Custom Voice Clips![/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387970/Squash_and_Spell__Kids_Typing/"][/dynamiclink]This one’s close to my heart, I made it for my daughter when she was little and wanted to mash keys like me. Now, anyone can add their own words and voice clips! Just drop a .wav file into a folder. It can be any language, as long as the words use the modern English alphabet and are 7 letters or fewer.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]- Super Carpark Walking Parking Simulator Turbo Updates! [/b][/h3][p]This game has been great fun to work on so far,  thank you all for the awesome feedback! [/p][p]We’ve now added a [b]roguelike deck-building system[/b]. It might sound crazy, but it fits perfectly. The goal has always been fun and chaos, and with cards you can now customize the experience:[/p][list][*][p]Too [b]fast[/b]? Pick a [i]Walk Slower[/i] card.[/p][/*][*][p]Too [b]easy[/b]? Add more cars with a [i]Spawn More[/i] card.[/p][/*][*][p]Too [b]boring[/b]? Cars are on fire or have rainbow trails.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We’re also working on:[/p][list][*][p]A [b]story mode[/b], where the carpark goes on an adventure[/p][/*][*][p]An [b]arcade mode[/b] with high scores.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam integration[/b] (leaderboards and achievements are live!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New environments[/b]: We’ve started on a country road setting, with suburbs and beaches on the way
[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks so much for sticking with us, can’t wait to show you more soon![/p][p][/p][p]– Frankie 🚗🅿️[/p][p]
[/p]
